test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.​

Q P _ R _ Q _ D _ T Q _ D R T _ P D _ T

options.text: D T P Q P Q R
D T P R P Q R
D T R P P Q R
D T P R P Q P

solution:
Given: Q P _ R _ Q _ D _ T Q _ D R T _ P D _ T

 
• D T P Q P Q R → Q P **D** R **T** - Q **P** D **Q** T - Q **P** D R T - **Q** P D **R** T
 
• D T P R P Q R → Q P **D** R **T** - Q **P** D **R** T - Q P
